content.text: {"id": "mm6318a4", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "the annual rate increased from 2.9 to 5.3 cases per 100,000 population"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "the primary and secondary syphilis rate among black men was 5.2 times that among white men"}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "count/rate", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "the annual rate increased from 2.9 to 5.3 cases per 100,000 population"}]}, {"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "accounting for 91.1% of all primary and secondary syphilis cases in 2013"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "the proportion of male primary and secondary syphilis cases attributed to MSM increased from 77.0%"}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "summary", "q": "from 5.1 cases per 100,000 population in 2005 to 9.8 in 2013"}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Across all four U.S. Census regions, primary and secondary syphilis rates were greater in 2013 than in 2005."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "the primary and secondary syphilis rate among black men was 5.2 times that among white men"}]}, {"v": "stratified/adjusted", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "the rate among black women was 13.3 times that among white women"}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "surveillance/descriptive", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "CDC analyzed notifiable disease surveillance data on reported syphilis"}]}, {"v": "before/after or trend", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Trends in annual primary and secondary syphilis"}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Trends in annual primary and secondary syphilis (representing more recently acquired infections, which usually are infectious) were analyzed for 2005–2013."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "where the sex of sex partners was reported for ≥70% of male primary and secondary syphilis cases"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Rates were calculated using population denominators from the U.S. Census Bureau."}], "confidence": "medium", "uncertain_fields": ["analytic_depth"]}
